`var = 1` is a grammar error, so a parse-phase SyntaxError is raised before evaluation.

null.x throws TypeError (ToObject on null).
RangeError is thrown where TypeError is expected.
PutValue on an unresolvable reference throws ReferenceError in strict mode code; requires a real strict run.
with is legal in sloppy code and resolves v from the object.
No flags means both modes run; with is an early SyntaxError in strict mode code.
raw: evaluated verbatim; the leading directive makes `public` a reserved word, so a parse SyntaxError occurs.

flags: [module] is outside the global-script bridge (documented runner limitation).
$262.agent is a host-only API (documented runner limitation).
tail-call-optimization is a documented QuickJS-ng engine gap.
